query:
SELECT
            stat_date,
            tasks_completed,
            tasks_created,
            CASE WHEN tasks_created = 0 THEN 0.0
                 ELSE LEAST(tasks_completed::float8 / tasks_created::float8, 1.0)
            END AS "completion_rate!: f64"
        FROM   daily_stats
        WHERE  user_id   = $1
          AND  stat_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3
        ORDER BY stat_date ASC
